key.decision_why: The author answered the triager's question and asked for review on a PR no maintainer was assigned to, so the triager needs a short note to decide on a hand-off; the approach and files are unchanged, so a new card isn't warranted.
key.action_why: The next day laurynmm removed "not ready", added "maintainer review" and assigned sahil839, while noting she wasn't sure his feedback on #38251 had been taken into account.
changed: The author updated the PR description to explain how this PR relates to #38251, which has merge conflicts and pending change requests.
The description now says the PR handles sahil839's concern from #38251 that the URL must not change when the modal is opened from the settings overlay.
The description says the approach is more focused: the tab-to-URL map lives only in hash_util.ts, and tab changes call browser_history.update() in the toggler callback.
No new code was pushed; the head commit is the same as when the feedback was given.
still_missing: It isn't shown whether sahil839's main feedback on #38251 has been applied: he wanted fewer changes, with the hash_util.ts additions reduced through preparatory refactors.
There are no automated tests; that checklist item is unchecked.
key.reply_ask: Thank the author for explaining the relationship to #38251, say the PR is moving to maintainer review with sahil839, and ask them to check that sahil839's feedback on #38251 about keeping the hash_util.ts changes small through a preparatory refactor is addressed.

must_have.fact: Recommends handing off: remove "not ready" and add "maintainer review", because the author answered the question about how the PR relates to #38251.
Names sahil839 as the reviewer, because he reviewed the earlier #38251 for this issue and is the top recent contributor to these files.
Says there was no new push since the feedback; the author only updated the PR description.
Flags that it's unclear whether sahil839's feedback on #38251 has been taken into account: keep the code changes minimal and shrink the hash_util.ts additions with preparatory refactors.
